notes.title: Checkout the new language!
notes.content:
[b]To all suspects[/b],

major announcement! A submodule has been added to support brains running on Spanish. Experience the improved connection with VaiR in your preferred language.  
Please make sure to keep your brain interface up to date!

Hasta la vista, suspect!

- [b]The YUNIFY[/b]

notes.title: Holidays are coming!
notes.content:
[b]To all suspects[/b],

major announcement! Due to VaiR's birthday party and the upcoming holidays, beVaiR is on SALE for a short time.
Please make sure to keep your brain interface up to date!

Enjoy the holidays!

- [b]The YUNIFY[/b]

notes.title: Enjoy the summer!
notes.content:
[b]To all suspects[/b],

major announcement! Due to the significant rise in temperature, all suspects are advised to ensure sufficient fluid intake and avoid direct sunlight. To ensure indoor entertainment, beVaiR is on SALE for a short time.
Please make sure to keep your brain interface up to date!

Enjoy the summer and have fun!

- [b]The YUNIFY[/b]

notes.title: Check out the updated Twitch integration!
notes.content:
[b]To all suspects[/b],

major announcement! The "Twitch Integration" module has been updated. The controls for the module for interacting with the chat via Twitch have been adjusted and the user experience has been improved. For more information, see the Integration Guide: www.bit.ly/bevairti
Please make sure to keep your brain interface up to date!

Check out the updated Twitch integration!

- [b]The YUNIFY[/b]

notes.title: Check out the new Twitch integration!
notes.content:
[b]To all suspects[/b],

major announcement! An integration module has been added for the "Twitch" category control group, which allows external access on the currently running process. Actions of the active user can now be influenced by attentive bystanders via chat message. Please refer to the integration guide: www.bit.ly/bevairti
Please make sure to keep your brain interface up to date!

Check out the new Twitch integration!

- [b]The YUNIFY[/b]

notes.title: Try out the new parameter settings!
notes.content:
[b]To all suspects[/b],

major announcement! The procedure for generating the simulation parameters was adapted to the test group. The values for “Easy”, “Medium” and “Hard” were extrapolated based on the measured values. It is expected that the simulation parameters are better tuned.
Please make sure to keep your brain interface up to date!

Try out the new parameter settings!

- [b]The YUNIFY[/b]
